priorityList: When running Firestarter, delay your first Combustion until the target is below 90% health.
Cast Combustion when ready and then go into the Combustion Priority List. Cast Combustion near the end of a hard-cast Fireball or Scorch (In Execute).
Cast Pyroblast when you have Hot Streak using Pyroblast Chaining after a Fireball or Scorch (In Execute) so they both land at the same time.
Cast Scorch if you have a Heat Shimmer proc and you are Without Hot Streak.
Cast Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak.
Cast Scorch as your filler to generate Hot Streak or Heating Up when In Execute (target below 30% health).
Cast Fireball as your filler to generate Hot Streak or Heating Up.
Combustion Priority List: Cast Meteor between 2 to 8 seconds of Combustion left, ensuring it lands before Combustion ends.
Combustion Priority List: Cast Pyroblast when you have Hot Streak.
Combustion Priority List: Cast Scorch when you have Heat Shimmer and no Hot Streak.
Combustion Priority List: Cast Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak.
Combustion Priority List: Cast Scorch to generate Hot Streak or Heating Up.
